From the layout

I’m Tawfeeqoh, a developer based in Nigeria. I build websites and automation workflows, and write The Margin. This portfolio brings those parts of my work together.

I start with the business and its visitors: what do people need to find, understand or do? Those answers guide the structure and design.

The website collection covers hospitality, beauty, food, logistics, fashion and automotive businesses. You can also watch my automation demonstrations or head to The Margin for my writing.

I want a website to feel considered from its opening screen to its enquiry page—and to work comfortably on a phone.

How I think

A few things
I take seriously.

01

Ask better questions.

What does the business need? Who is using this? What should happen next? The answers shape the work.

02

Make the details count.

Thoughtful layouts, clear navigation and useful interactions should support the same goal.

03

Keep the personality.

A business can be clear and credible without sounding like every other business.
